# 2026-11-21: Energy is the right noise model, and morphology decides where information sits {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
**Status:** promoted to @sec-right and @sec-langevin · **Checked by:** `tests/test_energy_whitening.py`
:::

**Question.** Is the energy metric the best way to model a body's resolution for
measuring mechanical intelligence, or only a reasonable one?

**Findings.**

1. Maximum entropy fixes the shape of the noise once energy is chosen as the constrained
   quantity, but it does not choose energy. Constraining mean action instead gives the
   quantum zero-point shape.
2. Energy is the only noise metric that is coordinate-free, assembled element by element,
   free of outside scales, symmetric in time and invariant under free motion
   (@thm-unique).
3. Invariance under free motion is equivalent to "free motion never creates
   information" (@prp-work). Under per-coordinate noise, free motion raised the stored
   information from 2 to 3.58 bits with no input at all.
4. Of the alternatives, only action weighting passes both the stiff-spring limit and the
   mesh-refinement limit. Locality and the classical regime exclude it. The
   frequency-weighted family converges in the stiff limit exactly when $p<2$, as
   predicted (@tbl-rules).
5. Whitening by the data gives every body the same bits (@prp-datadriven).
6. In a Langevin body, with noise injected through the dampers, every design gives the
   same 37.742 bits in the whole body. The limit is set by the damping at the contact,
   $JD^+J^\top=1/b_i$ (@prp-contact). The rigid leg's rotor holds 99.9% of that limit,
   and the SEA's rotor climbs from 6% to 99.5% with stiffness (@tbl-langevin).
7. A fixed angle noise on the rotor lets a resonant SEA beat the rigid leg by up to
   5.9 bits. Under energy noise, static or thermal, the resonance amplifies the noise at
   the rotor by the same factor, so that advantage is an artifact.

**Open from this note.** The constant 1/2 in @prp-contact is confirmed numerically but
proved only in continuous time (roadmap thread T3). The share in point 6 needs a
definition and properties of its own (thread T2, now in the research note on
[information propagation](2026-11-21-information-propagation.qmd)).
